ELK TALK Enters the Books Record
Sports Afield / January 1988

Reads the full source text. Historical claims, prices and contacts are reproduced as source material, with company-name styling standardized. Unclear words are marked. Resume may repeat the current passage.

ELK TALK by Don Laubach and Mark Henckel. Both are veteran hunters with a combined experience of over a half century of stalking and hunting elk in the West. Laubach has developed his own calls and a lexicon of "elk talk" that has enabled him to bag 12 elk in 12 consecutive years with bow and arrow. The book documents hunting strategies, describes elk habitat and lifestyle, and provides many interesting facts that should help readers succeed on a trophy hunt with gun or bow. From MT E.L.K., INC., Dept, SA, Box 85, Gardiner, MT 59030; $12.95 paperback, $19.95 clothbound; add $1.50 for postage.
